limitations: HTTP and MCP protocol handlers are exercised in-process because this sandbox blocks loopback TCP connections.
Low-level MemoryFabric and operator interfaces remain trusted-local and can inspect across tenants by design.
The explicit conceal_cross_tenant=False setting remains available for trusted operator diagnostics and must not be exposed to tenant callers.

surfaces.HTTP: authenticated AgentApi foreign fetch response matches nonexistent id; recall redacts foreign canary; writes use credential tenant; delete/infer routes absent
surfaces.MCP: foreign and nonexistent fetch errors match; extra tenant/scope args do not move writes; destructive and inference tools absent
surfaces.SDK: foreign recall excluded; foreign and nonexistent fetch decisions match; tenant override and destructive methods unavailable
surfaces.dashboard: eligibility for foreign id matches nonexistent-id details after normalizing the caller-supplied ID
surfaces.inference: tenant-scoped derive refuses a foreign premise with opaque NotFound
surfaces.typed_query: foreign structured values do not match or contribute to caller tenant candidate population
